name: One-Pan Creamy Tagliatelle
desc: Tagliatelle cooked right in a creamy tomato broth with cherry tomatoes, red onion and spinach.

source.title: One-Pan Creamy Tagliatelle
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 100 ml cooking cream or heavy cream
Salt and black pepper, to taste
1/4 cup (20 g) grated Parmesan, for topping

steps: In a large deep skillet with a lid (about 12 in), lay the tagliatelle nests in the center. Arrange the tomatoes, onion, spinach and garlic around and over them.
Dot the tomato paste over the pasta, then add the olive oil, dried herbs, a pinch of salt and pepper, the cream, and 250 ml of the broth so the pasta is mostly covered.

Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat, then cook about 15 min, stirring every few minutes to separate the nests. Add the remaining broth if the pan looks dry. It is done when the pasta is tender and the sauce is thick and creamy.
Taste for salt and pepper and top with the Parmesan.
tips: Serves 2 and takes about 15 minutes of cooking.
